scenario:
An enterprise-level analytics platform for a competitive robotics league is being designed to manage and analyze the performance of teams in various robotics competitions. The platform will capture detailed metrics on team performances, including points scored in specific game elements such as Cargo and Rocket placements, as well as overall efficiency metrics like Offensive Power Rating (OPR). 

The platform will store comprehensive competition data, enabling teams to perform in-depth analyses of their past performances and to strategize for future events. Teams can compare their scores against others, viewing breakdowns of scores by individual tasks like Cargo Side and Rocket placements at different heights (High, Mid, Low). The system will also track starting and climbing averages which are crucial for overall game performance.

The platform will support historical analytics allowing teams to see their progression over time and make data-driven decisions for improvements. League organizers will utilize this data to refine game designs and ensure fair and challenging competition dynamics. A robust user management system will be implemented to handle roles for team members, coaches, analysts, and administrators, providing tailored interfaces and dashboards for each user group.
